# Feature: V6 Konstrukte engine

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-03 — issue #346 -->

## Intent
Engine support for Constructs (Konstrukte): max 1 per player, Haltbarkeit Startphase tick, summon via playtest EK/Beschwörung hook, Herausfordern vs Haltbarkeit (stören/zerstören). No Default-Flip; no #347 UI.

## Preconditions
- Match with `v6Formula` / `meta.v6FormulaEnabled`
- Playtest EK recipe (Essenz + Beschwörung catalyst) outside locked Slice-1 105 catalog
- Opponent may have an active construct for challenge tests

## Happy Path
- [ ] EK Beschwörung places `player.construct` (instanceId + defId + Haltbarkeit); grants no Fetz
- [ ] New construct replaces existing immediately (old discarded)
- [ ] Own Startphase: Haltbarkeit −1; at 0 construct discarded
- [ ] CHALLENGE vs construct: value vs Haltbarkeit → none / stören / zerstören (same margin as Formel); no LP damage
- [ ] Unit tests in `src/game/`; `npm run checks` green

## Edge Cases
- [ ] No construct → Startphase tick is no-op for constructs
- [ ] Disturbed construct + any positive margin → destroy
- [ ] Slice-1 105 catalog unchanged (Beschwörung not in locked matrix)
- [ ] Construct is not equipment / not formula component

## Out of scope
- Konstrukt Play UI (#347)
- Full Beschwörungsritual technique matrix / Slice-1 catalog expansion
- Play-Default cutover; Default-Flip

## Security Coverage
- F-03: typed engine state / actions; UI does not invent construct rules
- P-04: local-only match state

## Regression
- [ ] Echo/Delay Startphase order preserved (Echo → Delay → Konstrukt → Fessel)
- [ ] Existing V6 TEK / Fessel / Affinity tests still pass

## Assumptions
- Initial Haltbarkeit = recipe primary.value (playtest default 3)
- Challenge margin table reused from `formulaChallengeOutcome` (diff ≥3 destroy; already disturbed → destroy)
- Disturbed clears on owner Startphase construct tick (parallel to Formel-Aufrichten)
- V6 formula-component challenges remain legal when present; construct is an additional target
